subject.title: fix(ui): consistently load and cache user avatars

question: Does the protected PR have sufficient independently inspectable live browser proof to merge its new credentialed avatar-fetch boundary?
rationale: The patch changes where Control UI browser credentials may be sent. The contributor describes robust tests and a Chromium scenario, but the supplied discussion does not include the claimed redacted artifact for a maintainer to inspect directly.

options.title: Request attached redacted proof
options.body: Ask for a screenshot, recording, terminal/network output, or linked artifact showing the authenticated canonical request, image decode, and cross-surface cache reuse; this is recommended.

options.title: Accept the stated test evidence
options.body: A maintainer may treat the reported local Chromium run and passing dedicated proof check as adequate if they independently trust that evidence.

recommendation.title: Request attached redacted proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a screenshot, recording, terminal/network output, or linked artifact showing the authenticated canonical request, image decode, and cross-surface cache reuse; this is recommended.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the implementation and can attach or link the claimed redacted proof artifact.
